purpose: An inline numbered reference in generated text (`[1]`), Cloudscape's inline citation: a small superscript number that links to the source — to item `n` of the `Sources` list under the response, or straight to the URL — with a tooltip naming the source and an accessible name of `Source 1: <title>`. `StreamingResponse` renders it for every `[n]`; use it directly when you build responses yourself.
useWhen: A statement in a generated response that comes from a specific source.
avoidWhen: A link the reader is meant to follow as part of the prose → a normal link.
related: sources` — the list citations point at.
streaming-response` — renders citations from `[n]` in Markdown.
bestPractices: Number in order of first use: [1], [2], [3].
Give every citation a `title`; a bare number tells a screen reader nothing.
